findings.evidence: Mathlib PointwiseConvergenceCLM.lean:155-159 defines `toPointwiseConvergenceCLM` with `__ := LinearMap.id`; the proof never rewrites the coercion, so it closes only by unfolding.
findings.fix: Add or reuse a simp lemma `toPointwiseConvergenceCLM_apply : toPointwiseConvergenceCLM 𝕜 σ E F f x = f x` and rewrite with it, e.g. `simpa only [toPointwiseConvergenceCLM_apply] using …`. Alternatively, add a comment naming the defeq it depends on.
findings.issue: `continuousOn_pointwise_comp_of_norm_le` passes the evaluations `toPointwiseConvergenceCLM … (S y) z` from `tendsto_iff_forall_tendsto.mp` straight into `tendsto_comp_apply_of_eventually_norm_le`, which expects `S y z`. It also matches the `toPointwiseConvergenceCLM … ((S x).comp (T x))` goal. Both rely on unstated definitional equality through the wrapper.

findings.evidence: Line 131: `exact IsStarProjection.of_tendsto_pointwise (le_principal_iff.mp hmem) (tendsto_iff_forall_tendsto.mp hlim)`, with no rewriting between the two coercions.
findings.fix: State an explicit coercion lemma (`⇑((ofFun σ F _).symm P) = ⇑P` or similar) and rewrite with it before applying `of_tendsto_pointwise`, or document the defeq in a comment.
findings.issue: `isClosed_setOf_isStarProjection` passes `tendsto_iff_forall_tendsto.mp hlim`, which evaluates through the wrapper's own coercion, as the `hlim` argument of `IsStarProjection.of_tendsto_pointwise`. There, `P i` is `(UniformConvergenceCLM.ofFun …).symm i`, so the two only agree by unfolding `ofFun.symm`.

findings.evidence: Line 130: `have := hl`; nothing in the proof refers to it by name.
findings.fix: If it is needed, write `haveI := hl` with a comment saying it supplies `l.NeBot` for `of_tendsto_pointwise`. Otherwise delete it.
findings.issue: `have := hl` has no comment, so a reader cannot tell whether it is needed (presumably to supply the `[l.NeBot]` instance) or is dead code.

summary: Two proofs work only because the PointwiseConvergenceCLM wrapper (via toPointwiseConvergenceCLM and ofFun.symm) unfolds to the plain operator, and nothing documents that. The closedness proof also has an unexplained `have := hl`.
